meta.name: Ride Recap Design System
meta.description: Brand tokens for video overlays, outro cards, and any future surface. Edit this file to rebrand the output; never hard-code a hex or font path in a module.

semantic.comment: Sage = chrome / start dot / hairlines / italic subtitle. Mint = live position dot, elevation dot, turn dot. Cream = primary text. Use semantic names in code; primitive hex values may shift if the brand evolves.

zones.comment: Cold-to-hot palette for power and HR effort bars. Identical to the original burn_overlay zone palette so the bars still tell the user 'I'm pushing hard'.

numeric.name: Barlow Condensed Bold
numeric.purpose: All hero numerics — speed, power, HR, cadence, gradient, distance, watts. Cycling-stat language.

numeric_regular.name: Barlow Condensed Regular
numeric_regular.purpose: Secondary numbers — total distance caption, elevation label.

body.name: Inter
body.purpose: All labels (MPH, BPM, DISTANCE, ELEVATION, AVG SPEED), lockups, eyebrows, footer. Race-bib letter tracking applied at the call site.

serif.name: Times New Roman Italic
serif.note: The one face not shipped with the package (Times is not redistributable). tokens.py probes this path, then common Linux serif locations, then falls back to the body font. Relative font paths resolve against the gopro_garmin_pipeline package root.
serif.purpose: One italic moment per surface — the outro-card subtitle. Sage colored. Use sparingly; this is the only serif in the system.

typography.comment: Stroke = tight black outline for legibility on bright/varied video backgrounds (no offset shadow — flat outline only). Label tracking = letterspacing on small-caps labels (MPH, W, BPM, RPM) for race-bib feel.

lockups.comment: Last-resort fallbacks only — used when GPS derivation is off (no OSM_CONTACT_EMAIL) and no CLI override was passed. Normally origin/destination/road come from the ride's GPS. Set these to your own home turf if you ride the same roads every week, e.g. origin_default 'HUDSON YARDS', road_default '9W'. outro_subtitle is the italic line under the recap title; empty means no line.

spacing.comment: 8pt base. Aspirational: new paddings, gaps, and offsets should come from this scale; the drawing code predates it and still carries hand-tuned pixel values.

radius.comment: Sharp corners. PNS / race-bib clean — no rounded boxes.

video_overlay.hud: 5-element stack on the left — speed, power, HR, cadence, gradient. No icons. Big Barlow Bold value, tracked Inter label below the bar. Bars colored by zone (cold-to-hot). Power and cadence render as `--` when sensor reads 0 mid-coast (avoids 'missing data' read).
video_overlay.minimap: Heading-up circle, top-right. Sage hairline border. Sage chevron. ~12% landscape / ~18% portrait.
video_overlay.route_trace: Right margin, white-on-black-stroke (matches elevation styling exactly via shared _TraceStyle.draw_line). Mint position dot.
video_overlay.elevation_profile: Bottom-center sparkline. Mint dot. Altitude label in cream Barlow Regular.
video_overlay.lockup_band: Sage hairline rule. Lockup left-aligned to elevation profile left edge: '{ORIGIN} · {ROAD}', e.g. 'HUDSON YARDS · 9W' (GPS-derived per ride). Odometer right-aligned to elevation profile right edge: '21.37 / 48.84 MI' (both numbers in Barlow Bold, two decimals, alpha alone carries hierarchy).

outro_card.title: Inter Bold, all-caps, two lines: '{ORIGIN} / → {DESTINATION}'. Cream.
outro_card.subtitle: Times Italic. Sage. Single line — e.g. 'the long way home.'
outro_card.stats_grid: 3-column grid, 2 rows. Top row: distance / elevation / avg speed. Bottom row column-aligns to top: avg watts under distance, moving time under elevation, nothing under avg speed.
outro_card.stats_decimals: Distance: 2. Avg speed: 1. Avg watts: 0. Elevation: 0 (with thousands separator). Moving time: H:MM.
outro_card.route_hero: Right ~55% landscape / centered portrait. Cream line with sage glow + black halo. Sage start dot, mint turn dot. Place names labeled in Inter at the dots.
outro_card.footer: Tiny Inter, 'ROAD · CREW'. No rule above (declutter).
